The '''Battle of Galboron''' was the last battle of the [[Noolian Crisis]]. It originated with the capture of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] by the Republic in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the refusal of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] to surrender after the close of the conflict. Those two groups joined forces to launch a [[Noolian Crisis|campaign]] of raids which culminated with their destruction at the hands of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Par Lankin]] at [[Galboron]].

==Aftermath==
In later years, the victory would be one of many that a player could simulate on [[Plescinia Entertainments/Legends|Plescinia Entertainments]]' [[CS-Mark 10]] Imperial Command Combat Simulator.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
